house_style: Rich, tactile fine-art illustrations for a grade 3 to 5 dance studio. Painterly layered color, subtle paper grain, beautifully composed silhouettes and directional light. Original compositions. No text, lettering, numbers or logos.

assets.name: studio-light
assets.prompt: Empty contemporary dance rehearsal studio, front view, violet-charcoal plaster wall, large muted violet mirror reflecting soft light, slate gray marley floor. Warm daylight enters from upper left, soft diagonal shafts of dust and subtle floor reflections, rich gouache and pencil surface texture, calm atmospheric depth. Wide central empty space for a code dancer. No barre, furniture, equipment or text. No people, faces or body parts.

assets.name: painting-river
assets.prompt: A slow wide river at dusk in the style of Japanese woodblock prints, flat bands of indigo blue and peach, a single heron wading in shallow water at the lower left, drifting mist over reeds across the middle right, a low pale moon at upper right, still water with gentle curved ripples across the bottom center. Full-frame landscape, delicate carved lines and textured pigments, a quiet luminous twilight. No people, faces or human body parts.

assets.name: painting-storm
assets.prompt: A thunderstorm over rolling green hills in the style of Romantic landscape painting. A bright jagged lightning bolt at upper right, trees bending in the wind at lower left, huge dark rolling clouds at upper center, slanting sheets of pouring rain across the right hillside. Dramatic light from the lightning, rich oil-paint impasto and atmospheric depth. Full-frame landscape. No people, faces or human body parts.

assets.name: poem-card
assets.prompt: A single sheet of soft ivory handmade paper with a deckled edge, blank, lying flat on a pale warm neutral surface, viewed directly from above. Gentle light from upper left, soft natural shadow, subtle cotton fibers and delicate grain. Spacious clean center for a poem to be added in code. Full frame. No people, faces or human body parts.
